cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Withdraw the Objection
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to drop a complaint, challenge, or special request and accept the official process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Please drop the request for a private tea queue. Everyone at the fete uses this one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I donated the tent. Can't that count for something?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. It does. Your name's on the thank-you board beside the queue.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody can read it behind that urn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll move the urn. You can accept everyone's thanks while you wait your turn.

mechanism: A corrects a donor's proposed privilege into proper acknowledgment, fixing a recognition defect so B accepts the public queue.
confusable: Refusing help outright would miss D180 persuasion; A should solve the real concern while retaining the process.
comparison: Public donor status differs from collaborative evidence submission.
seedUse: Keep donated tent, obscured board and moving urn, making A's expert correction distinguish recognition from priority.
